translations.text: Do you renounce the devils? I renounce them. Do you renounce the works and wills of the devils? I renounce them. Do you renounce all heathen practices?
I renounce them. Do you renounce all heathen sacrifices and boastings, which heathen men held as sacrifices and offerings? I renounce them.
Do you believe in God the Father almighty? I believe. Do you believe in the holy Son of God, that he was born and suffered martyrdom? I believe.

Do you believe in the Holy Spirit, and in the holy assembly, and the communion of saints, the resurrection of the flesh, that you shall stand on Judgment Day in the flesh in which you now are? And do you believe in life after death?
I believe. Here follows: Breathe into his face and say this prayer: Go out from him, unclean spirit, and give honour to the living and true God.
